notes.title: Remake of strange, rare R-Type Tactics 1 & 2 to release in Fall 2024
notes.content: The modernized and remade PC version of tactical shoot 'em up R-Type Tactics 1 and 2 is clearly not coming this year as previously listed. Developer Granzella has announced that R-Type Tactics I - II Cosmos is in fact coming in fall 2024, instead, during a recent livestream... Read more.
